_comment: The app's brand mark — the logo in the header and on the sign-in page. Paths are relative to public/ and must live under public/brand/. Empty (null) means the letter tile built from APP_NAME, which is what a fresh app shows and is a perfectly good answer. Filled in by `node run.mjs brand`, or by hand. The guide is docs/design-system.md.
_comment_dark: logoDark is only needed when the light mark disappears on the dark background — a dark wordmark on near-black. One file is the normal case.
_comment_size: logoWidth/logoHeight are the file's own pixel (or viewBox) dimensions. They are not optional when logo is set: without them the has no intrinsic ratio and the header row jumps on first paint.
_comment_svg: An SVG is allowed HERE and nowhere else in this app. It is a build-time asset the operator put in their own repo, it never travels through lib/media/, and it is rendered only through . See docs/design-system.md and components/brand-mark.test.ts.
